cues.en: Hi, and welcome to yet another AI and C-Sharp video about in this case, Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎收看另一支 C# AI 影片，這次的主題是 Agent Framework Toolkit。

cues.en: So Agent Framework Toolkit, if you don't know, is a set of NuGet packages I have put on top of Microsoft Agent Framework to make it easier.
cues.zh: 如果還不知道，Agent Framework Toolkit 是我建立在 Microsoft Agent Framework 之上的一組 NuGet 套件，讓使用更方便。

cues.en: But in that make it easier part, I have over time now seen that certain things can be a little cumbersome to do.
cues.zh: 不過隨著時間過去，我發現某些步驟仍然有點繁瑣。

cues.en: So I made some further changes that makes it even easier now.
cues.zh: 所以又做了一些變更，讓它更容易使用。

cues.en: So what is this all about?
cues.zh: 這次到底改了什麼呢？

cues.en: So for example, if we have Azure OpenAI here, where we need to make an responses client as AI agent,
cues.zh: 例如這裡使用 Azure OpenAI，要透過 Responses Client 建立 AI Agent，

cues.en: and we want to set the reasoning effort and verbosity, or it could be some of the other more advanced things, we end up with this layout model of needing to set the model
cues.zh: 並設定推理強度與回覆詳細程度，或其他進階選項，就會出現這種多層結構：先設定模型，

cues.en: and options that then need some chat option that then needs some raw representation factory that then needs some reasoning options before you can finally set these two simple little things.
cues.zh: 再指定選項、ChatOptions、RawRepresentationFactory，最後進入 ReasoningOptions，才能設定這兩個小選項。

cues.en: And this is just way too much code, it is way too difficult to know that you need to make one of these because this is just an object
cues.zh: 程式碼實在太多，而且很難知道這裡必須建立哪種物件，因為型別只顯示 object，

cues.en: and you need to know exactly that this is this.
cues.zh: 你必須事先知道正確的型別。

cues.en: And for that reason, I made Microsoft Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 這就是我建立 Agent Framework Toolkit 的原因。

cues.en: And the same as this does over here is done in way less code over here.
cues.zh: 同樣的工作，可以用這裡少得多的程式碼完成。

cues.en: And you can see it's just a very, very flat model, you don't need to go into multiple layers, and everything can be supported here, including middleware,
cues.zh: 可以看到，設定是完全扁平的，不必深入好幾層；連中介軟體在內的所有選項都支援，

cues.en: and everything is just discoverable much more.
cues.zh: 而且更容易探索與找到需要的功能。

cues.en: But there is a problem though, because if we look at this code over here, and this code over here, almost nothing of it is the same.
cues.zh: 不過仍有一個問題：比較左右兩份程式碼，幾乎沒有相同的部分。

cues.en: We have the secrets up here, and we have the responses at the end down here.
cues.zh: 只有上方的秘密設定，以及下方處理回覆的部分一樣。

cues.en: But everything else is different, because we need to do an Azure OpenAI factory, we need to say factory.createAgent.
cues.zh: 其餘都不同，因為得改成 AzureOpenAIFactory，再呼叫 factory.CreateAgent。

cues.en: But in here is the nice part, but all the rest is difficult.
cues.zh: 裡面的選項很好用，但外面的遷移過程還是麻煩。

cues.en: Another thing is that Agent Framework Toolkit by default uses the chat client, because that's the most compatible.
cues.zh: 另一個問題是，Agent Framework Toolkit 預設使用相容性較好的 Chat Client。

cues.en: But over time, almost none of the new features like ChatGPT 6, together with tools, work only on responses API.
cues.zh: 但後來許多新功能，例如 GPT-6 搭配工具，只能透過 Responses API 使用。

cues.en: So now we end up needing to set this client type every single time in order for Agent Framework Toolkit to use the latest free features as well.
cues.zh: 所以為了使用最新功能，現在每次都必須另外設定 ClientType。

cues.en: So it's become a little cumbersome, because I can't really change this, because that would be a breaking change or behavioral change without a break at all.
cues.zh: 這變得有點繁瑣，但我也不能直接更改預設，否則即使程式不會編譯失敗，仍會改變既有行為。

cues.en: So I just wanted to fix that.
cues.zh: 所以我想解決這個問題。

cues.en: The chore of going from here to here is so big, and the responses API.
cues.zh: 從原本程式碼改成 Factory 寫法的負擔，以及 Responses API 的選擇，都需要改善。

cues.en: So let me show you live with this code, how we can use Agent Framework Toolkit, but in a better manner.
cues.zh: 接著直接修改這段程式碼，示範更好的 Toolkit 使用方式。

cues.en: So here we have the same code that is not using Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 這裡是尚未使用 Agent Framework Toolkit 的原始程式碼。

cues.en: And below we have how we need to change it using the factory system and everything.
cues.zh: 下方則是原本透過 Factory 系統遷移後的寫法。

cues.en: But there's a new way of doing it in Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 不過現在 Toolkit 有新的使用方式。

cues.en: And I'm just using the Agent Framework Toolkit, Azure OpenAI here, without anything else.
cues.zh: 這裡只需要加入 Agent Framework Toolkit 的 Azure OpenAI 套件，不必額外做其他事情。

cues.en: And let me try to change this on the fly.
cues.zh: 我們直接修改看看。

cues.en: So first off, we don't really want to tell if we want to use the responses client or the chat client anymore.
cues.zh: 首先，不想每次都指定使用 Responses Client 還是 Chat Client。

cues.en: We always want to use responses client.
cues.zh: 我們希望預設使用 Responses Client。

cues.en: That's OpenAI, that's Azure OpenAI's default now.
cues.zh: 現在 OpenAI 與 Azure OpenAI 都以此為預設方向。

cues.en: Let's just get rid of it.
cues.zh: 所以把這段移除。

cues.en: And there's suddenly an SAIAgent here that uses the Agent Framework Toolkit part of it.
cues.zh: 接著就會出現 Toolkit 提供的 AsAIAgent 多載。

cues.en: So we need to say new agent options.
cues.zh: 在這裡建立新的 AgentOptions。

cues.en: And then let's get rid of a few things.
cues.zh: 然後移除幾個不需要的部分。

cues.en: We need the model still, but it doesn't need to be in multiple levels.
cues.zh: 模型仍然要指定，但不必藏在多層設定中。

cues.en: So we can just get rid of it here and say it's the model.
cues.zh: 所以可以移除原本的位置，直接設在 Model。

cues.en: Then we don't need the chat options.
cues.zh: 接著不需要 ChatOptions 這一層。

cues.en: We don't need the reputation factory.
cues.zh: 也不需要 RawRepresentationFactory。

cues.en: We don't need the reasoning options.
cues.zh: 不需要 ReasoningOptions。

cues.en: We just need these two lines.
cues.zh: 只需要這兩行設定。

cues.en: And because I wanted to have it a bit more simple to look at, I called this reasoning effort.
cues.zh: 為了讓名稱更容易理解，我把這個選項稱為 ReasoningEffort。

cues.en: And it's an enum, we need to go high.
cues.zh: 它是一個列舉，這裡選 High。

cues.en: And the verbosity is the same name, but just in a different nougat.
cues.zh: Verbosity 名稱相同，只是型別來自另一個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: And with those few changes, we are now on Agent Framework Toolkit.
cues.zh: 只做這幾項變更，就已經改用 Agent Framework Toolkit 了。

cues.en: We didn't need to change anything up here.
cues.zh: 不需要更動上方的程式碼。

cues.en: We didn't need to change anything down here.
cues.zh: 也不需要更動下方的程式碼。

cues.en: We can just simply go and remove a few lines of code, add a name change here, and then we are ready.
cues.zh: 只要移除幾行、調整這個名稱，就可以使用。

cues.en: So again, if we go back and see this, a lot of code can be taken away, but we're not really changing too, too much.
cues.zh: 回頭比較，可以刪除大量程式碼，但其實不需要大幅改寫。

cues.en: We're just sending in the different parameters to SAIAgent because it's simply just a new overload.
cues.zh: 只是把不同的參數傳給 AsAIAgent，因為它本質上只是新多載。

cues.en: This is the one from Agent Framework itself, these two, and here's the new one.
cues.zh: 這兩個是 Agent Framework 原本的多載，而這個是新加入的。

cues.en: And it does exactly the same.
cues.zh: 它們完成的工作完全相同。

cues.en: So we go from here and to here.
cues.zh: 因此程式碼就從這樣，變成這樣。

cues.en: So now it's not as daunting to go and grab the new system.
cues.zh: 現在要改用這個系統，就沒那麼令人卻步。

cues.en: We don't need to use the factories anymore if we don't want to.
cues.zh: 如果不想使用 Factory，也不必使用。

cues.en: The factories have a few slight features extra than that the extension method can't have,
cues.zh: Factory 仍然有少數擴充方法無法提供的額外功能，

cues.en: like, for example, raw core details, but we don't really use that in day-to-day.
cues.zh: 例如 RawCallDetails，不過一般開發不常用。

cues.en: It's mostly for me showing off and debugging when I do these presentations.
cues.zh: 主要是我做簡報時，用來示範與除錯。

cues.en: So again, if we see it, get rid of this, write new agent options, grab your model,
cues.zh: 所以再看一次：移除這段、建立 AgentOptions、取出模型，

cues.en: remove the lines, add the model in,
cues.zh: 刪除多餘層級，再把模型加進來，

cues.en: remove the lines,
cues.zh: 移除其他不必要的層級，

cues.en: call this reasoning effort, and use the better-named enums.
cues.zh: 改用 ReasoningEffort，以及名稱更清楚的列舉。

cues.en: And you're ready to go.
cues.zh: 這樣就完成了。

cues.en: So this just makes it so much easier for you to switch over.
cues.zh: 因此遷移變得簡單多了。

cues.en: And again, as always in Agent Framework Toolkit, the second you are down here, everything is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 而且和 Toolkit 一貫的設計一樣，建立代理程式之後，下方所有用法都完全相同。

cues.en: That's the good part of Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 這就是 Agent Framework 很好的部分。

cues.en: The only bad part has been how we define the agent, and that is what Agent Framework Toolkit fixes and now makes it even easier.
cues.zh: 原本比較麻煩的是代理程式定義，而 Toolkit 正是為了解決這一點，現在又更方便了。

cues.en: So with that, thank you, and see you on the next one.
cues.zh: 謝謝收看，我們下支影片見。
